notes: 0.3.34：本机路径卡加「修改」+ 页面梳理。之前这张卡一进面板就是三个输入框常驻，跟其它卡「先只读、点修改才解锁」不一致，也容易误改。现在默认只读：三行根用等宽字显示当前值，下面一行灰字标出它对应的占位符（{{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}），自选目录同样展示；点右上「修改」才变输入框，配「保存 / 取消」，保存后自动回只读。编辑态多了两件事——每个自选目录右「删除」，以及下面一行「新增目录」（键名 + 路径，键名只收字母数字和 _ . -），插件装在别处的根可以直接补。三个根都没探测到时仍强制停在编辑态，不会让人对着空白发呆。页面本身也顺了一遍：卡片间距和行高放宽、中文键名列从 92px 加到 100px 不再挤成两行、按钮高度加到 22px 更好点、标题下补一行导语说清「本机→仓库→云端」的流转、补上「退出后执行」缺的分区说明。README 中英同步梳理：安装命令里的写死版本号改成占位（不再每次发版都要改文档），新增「本机路径卡怎么用」与「统一交互」两节，截图注明取自 0.3.14。
notesEn: 0.3.34: Edit button on the Local paths card, plus a page tidy-up. That card used to drop three input boxes on you the moment the panel opened, unlike every other card ("read-only first, Edit unlocks"), and easy to change by accident. It now renders read-only: the three roots show their current value in monospace with the placeholder underneath as a grey hint ({{APP_ROOT}} / {{DSH_HOME}} / {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}), custom folders likewise; Edit turns them into inputs with Save / Cancel, and a successful save returns to read-only. Edit mode adds two things: Remove next to each custom folder, and an Add folder row (key + path, key limited to letters, digits, _ . -) so roots living elsewhere can be added directly. When not a single root is detected the card still stays in edit mode rather than leaving you staring at blanks. The page itself was tidied as well: looser card spacing and line height, the Chinese label column widened from 92px to 100px so labels stop wrapping, buttons at 22px for easier clicking, a lead line under the title explaining the local -> repo -> cloud flow, and the missing hint for the After exit section. README updated in both languages: the hard-coded version in the install command became a placeholder (no more doc edit per release), two new sections cover "how the Local paths card works" and "consistent interaction", and the screenshot is marked as taken from 0.3.14.
